prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one isolated icon for the existing piercing/refraction upgrade.
Primary request: Edit Image 1, the exact existing prism icon. Remove the foreign image fragments beneath the item and restore the clean complete silhouette.
Input images: Image 1: exact existing prism icon; edit target.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background.
Subject: exactly one glowing amber faceted prism enclosed in its existing brass frame.
Style/medium: preserve the reference's detailed rendered-item finish.
Composition/framing: center the complete prism with about 8% transparent margin on every side; do not crop any part of the frame or silhouette.
Lighting/mood: preserve the warm internal amber glow and reference lighting.
Color palette: preserve the existing amber, orange, dark metal, and brass palette.
Materials/textures: preserve the current optical materials, facets, brass frame, outline, proportions, and surface detail.
Constraints: preserve the prism's present identity, outline, facets, materials, proportions, palette, and the entire silhouette; remove only the foreign fragments beneath it; no redesign and no beam. Keep the main outline and facets readable at 48 and 64 px on both #102a2e and #eee8d8.
Avoid: words, logo, border, pedestal, scene, extra crystal, detached light rays, debris, watermark, cropping, or any second item.
output_hint:
